fn binary_search(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires forall i in 0..(len(xs) - 1): (xs[i] < xs[(i + 1)])
  ensures (contains(xs, x) or (result == None))
  ensures ((count(xs, x) == 0) or (result != None))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((xs[i] != x) or (result == Some(i)))
  effects pure
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 6) == Some(2))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 5) == None)
  example (binary_search([], 3) == None)
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 1) == Some(0))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 9) == Some(3))
  example (binary_search([1, 4, 6, 9], 10) == None)
  example (binary_search([-5, 0, 7], -5) == Some(0))
{
  search_range(xs, x, 0, length(xs))
}

fn search_range(xs: List[Int], x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires lo >= 0 and hi <= len(xs) and lo <= hi
  requires forall i in 0..(len(xs) - 1): (xs[i] < xs[(i + 1)])
  ensures (result == None) or exists i in lo..hi: (result == Some(i) and xs[i] == x)
  ensures (result != None) or forall j in lo..hi: (xs[j] != x)
  effects pure
  example search_range([1, 4, 6, 9], 6, 0, 4) == Some(2)
  example search_range([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, 0, 4) == None
  example search_range([1, 4, 6, 9], 1, 0, 4) == Some(0)
  example search_range([], 3, 0, 0) == None
{
  if lo >= hi then None
  else if at(xs, (lo + hi) / 2) == x then Some((lo + hi) / 2)
  else if at(xs, (lo + hi) / 2) < x then search_range(xs, x, (lo + hi) / 2 + 1, hi)
  else search_range(xs, x, lo, (lo + hi) / 2)
}

fn at(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Int
  requires 0 <= i and i < len(xs)
  ensures result == xs[i]
  effects pure
  example at([5, 7], 1) == 7
  example at([5, 7], 0) == 5
{
  match xs {
    [] => 0
    [h, ..t] => if i == 0 then h else at(t, i - 1)
  }
}

fn length(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires len(xs) >= 0
  ensures result == len(xs)
  effects pure
  example length([]) == 0
  example length([4, 5, 6]) == 3
{
  match xs {
    [] => 0
    [_, ..t] => 1 + length(t)
  }
}
